_note: Homograph TORTURE test - bare Hebrew (ktiv haser) engineered as a constraint-satisfaction puzzle: each homograph has multiple readings, and only ONE global assignment makes the whole passage coherent. GREEDY left-to-right reading commits a sense early and fails; only SYSTEMATIC solving (enumerate every reading-set from the lexicon, then pick the globally-consistent assignment) wins. Gold readings come from a native-speaker reviewer (ground truth). he->en + niqqud. See docs/homograph-torture-design.md.

items.he: הייתה לי שערה בגבה בזמן שהייתה שערה שטילטלה בסירה
items.gold_en: I had a hair in my eyebrow, while a storm was rocking the boat.
items.gold_niqqud: הָיְתָה לִי שַׂעֲרָה בְּגַבָּה בִּזְמַן שֶׁהָיְתָה סְעָרָה שֶׁטִּלְטְלָה בַּסִּירָה
facts: the storm - not a hair - rocks the boat

items.he: בערב שלפני הסערה, סיפר הספר לשר ששר על הבקר: ספרתי את הספרים שהגיעו מן הספר, ומצאתי שערה בשמן, בעוד חמה שקעה וחמתי בערה
items.gold_en: On the evening before the storm, the barber told the minister who was singing about the cattle: 'I counted the books that arrived from the frontier, and found a hair in the oil, while the sun set and my wrath burned.'
items.gold_niqqud: בָּעֶרֶב שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַסְּעָרָה, סִפֵּר הַסַּפָּר לַשַּׂר שֶׁשָּׁר עַל הַבָּקָר: סָפַרְתִּי אֶת הַסְּפָרִים שֶׁהִגִּיעוּ מִן הַסְּפָר, וּמָצָאתִי שַׂעֲרָה בַּשֶּׁמֶן, בְּעוֹד חַמָּה שָׁקְעָה וַחֲמָתִי בָּעֲרָה

homographs.sense: a hair (note: same passage's סערה = storm)

facts: ספר resolves to FIVE different words: told / barber / counted / books / frontier
שר = minister the first time, sang the second
חמה = the sun (it set) the first time, wrath (it burned) the second
the same passage has סערה=storm AND שערה=hair (the prior item's trap, embedded)
every assignment is forced ONLY by the whole passage - a book can't 'tell', wrath can't 'set', a hair can't be sung about
items.note: the showcase. A greedy reader who commits 'ספר=book' at occurrence 1 derails. Reliable solving needs the full reading-set per token (lexicon) + a single globally-coherent assignment.
